thread:
ada: quick heads-up — brought up rerank-v3-mp (mixed-precision fp16+int8 paths) in eval harness this morning, overall NDCG +0.78% vs rerank-v2, but MRR on 'long-doc' cohort dropped ~2.1%. https://internal.evals/1739991234 :thinking:

theo: what's our long-doc cutoff here? is it >2048 tokens or char-based?

priya: cohort = docs where original content length > 8k chars (we chunk to 2k windows for candidates). cutoff param used: --chunk-size 2048.

sam: repro command I ran:
```bash
python eval/run_eval.py --model rerank-v3-mp --quant mixed --chunk-size 2048 --cohort longdocs --metrics ndcg,mrr --seed 42
```
logs attached in the eval run.

ada: eval-bot summary pasted the numbers: NDCG_all +0.78%, MRR_all +0.05% (ns), MRR_long -2.12% (p=0.006). variance higher for longdocs (std +14%).

priya: suspicion: mixed-precision path changed score scale for partial-window candidates. We normalize by L2 before softmax in v2; v3-mp pipeline may have slight numerical drift; could alter top-1 ordering for long contexts where many near-ties exist.

theo: interesting — do we see any difference in candidate length distribution or truncation frequency between runs?

sam: checked that: truncation rate of candidates up from 7.2% -> 9.8% on long cohort (v2 -> v3-mp). seems like kv-cache chunking offset differs by a token in some windows.

ada: oof. that could explain MRR drop (ranking sensitive to small score perturbations). would expect NDCG less sensitive because it averages over ranks.

priya: quick ablation plan:
- run v3-mp with explicit fp32 score-accumulation (no cast) to see if numeric accumulation fixes it
- run v3-mp with identical chunker from v2 (force same offsets)
- run v2 with matching mixed quant path to check model-only vs runtime differences

can someone trigger the first two?

sam: triggering now — 2 jobs queued: job/1739991234-accum-fp32 and job/1739991234-chunker-v2. will report within 3h.

eval-bot: job/1739991234-accum-fp32 finished: MRR_long delta = -0.3% (p=0.34), NDCG_all +0.74%. job/1739991234-chunker-v2 finished: MRR_long delta = +0.1% (p=0.81), NDCG_all +0.76%.

theo: looks like chunker alignment is the main suspect — when windows align, long-doc MRR recovers. good catch.

ada: /cc @infra — can we add an automated alignment test between runtime chunker and eval harness chunker? small unit test to compare window offsets on same input.

priya: also suggests we should add a long-doc near-tie set for regression alerts (10k queries sampled from tails). current CI focuses on avg NDCG.

sam: created GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rerank/issues/445 — includes reproducer and eval artifacts. tagging for prioritization.

ada: next steps: (1) infra test for chunker parity, (2) add long-doc near-tie regression to eval smoke, (3) keep mixed-precision path but run with explicit score-accum fp32 until autotune validated. assign Priya for (2), Theo for (1).

priya: happy to own the long-doc regression set. I'll push a small eval hook by EOD.

theo: I'll add the chunker parity test to infra CI and a one-off that runs on bring-up merges.

ada: thanks all. short note for release: do not enable v3-mp by default on Dedicated until chunker parity and long-doc regression pass. :white_check_mark:
